body.statement: For every \(k\ge1\), there is an envelope with \(b=2\), \(O(k)\) vertices and edges, and \(|\mathcal O_{XY}|=2^k\). There is also a family with \(b=2\) and polynomial-size \(\mathcal O_{XY}\) whose incidence treewidth is unbounded.
body.justification: The two constructions separate causal district width, output size, and reliability-evaluation width.
body.gap: Neither causal identification nor classical reliability work records this three-way parameter separation for uncertain ADMG queries.
body.consumer: It prevents misleading total-time claims and guides whether users should enumerate, compile by incidence width, or approximate.
